public static String mangle(String s) {
  if ((s == null) || (s.equals("")))
    return "";
  else 
    return s.charAt(0) + 
               mangle(s.substring(
                        s.length()/2 + 1));
}

public static int howMany(int x) {
  if (x < 0) x = -x;
  int total = 0;
  while (x != 0) {
    if (x%2 == 1) total++;
    x /= 2;
  } 
  return total;
}
